explanation: I found no separate declaration stating that SetRel composition distributes over an indexed union on the left. I grepped Mathlib for iUnion_comp, comp_iUnion, sUnion_comp and iSup_comp variants. I also checked the SetRel.comp, Rel.comp and Relation.Comp files. The only hits were the siblings in the same file (SetRel.comp_iUnion, SetRel.sUnion_comp, SetRel.comp_sUnion), which are different statements. The Set.iUnion_comp hits are about reindexing a union along a surjection, which is unrelated.
